hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command '$cmd = $env:CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT; if ($cmd -match "rm\s+-rf|git\s+push\s+--force|git\s+reset\s+--hard|git\s+clean\s+-f|DROP\s+TABLE|firebase\s+deploy\s+--project\s+prod") { Write-Error "BLOCKED / BLOCCATO: Risky command detected. Ask owner before proceeding. Comando pericoloso rilevato. Chiedi conferma al proprietario prima di procedere."; exit 2 }'

powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command '$file = $env:CLAUDE_FILE_PATH; if ($file -match "server\.ts$|firestore\.rules$|src[\\/]config[\\/]admin\.ts$") { Write-Warning "HIGH-RISK FILE / FILE AD ALTO RISCHIO: $file. Double-check the change before continuing. Verifica attentamente le modifiche prima di procedere." }'
